title: Create retrieval confidence scoring module chatbot/memory/confidence.py
description:
Create retrieval confidence scoring module chatbot/memory/confidence.py to compute relevance scores for memories. Low-relevance memories falling below a specified threshold should be dropped/filtered.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/memory/confidence.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use mathematical formula or thresholding based on vector distances
support custom relevance criteria in scoring
forbidden: load embeddings models directly inside this module
